releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.142:
- INDEPENDENT STATION AUTO-UPDATE ARCHITECTURE: Every cashier station and kitchen screen updates its own local disk (C:\Impossible_POS) independently with one click.
- SILENT AUTOMATIC DRIVER INSTALLATION: digitalpersona_setup.msi installed in background automatically on stations without manual prompts.
- NATIVE BIOMETRIC ENGINE: DPFPBridge.exe and native manufacturer DLLs installed in System_Files and bin, auto-spawned in background.
- INDEPENDENT PHYSICAL POWER CONTROLS: Hardware ACPI Shutdown & Restart on each station physically without affecting the server.
- SINGLE PROMINENT SAVE BUTTON: Maintained one clear green SAVE CHANGES button in modal footer.
- MODIFIERS NUMBERING & SHIFT ARROWS: Added column numbering (#1, #2, #3) and left/right shift arrows (◀ / ▶) on modifier columns.
- MODIFIERS ITEMS REORDERING: Added up/down arrows (▲ / ▼) on every modifier option.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings verified across all integrity auditors.
